_description: MEIC's arm registry: named overrides of the base config (config.json / ~/.cherrypick/config/meic.json), applied per tick by the paper loop -- every enabled profile is evaluated on every tick as its own arm. This is the shipped EXAMPLE and holds only `control`. Your own registry lives at ~/.cherrypick/config/meic.risk.json (or $MEIC_RISK_CONFIG); copy this file there to start one, then add arms beside control. MEIC reads the home copy when it exists and this example otherwise. See docs/paper-experiments.md for how arms are designed and read.

control._note: Renamed from 'open' 2026-08-21 EOD — the era's control is the permissive sampling book (ledger rows before 2026-08-21 stamped 'open' are this same stream; era-day-1 rows were re-stamped in the same amendment). || Design note as it stood before the rename: The permissive superset (2026-08-07): every study gate off (IV floor, OTM floor, ATR/VIX/VIX1D regime pauses, GEX block/require/magnitude, late-entry bias), no per-side stop (per_side_stop_management false — held to settlement/force-close, reusing the existing hold-to-expiry mechanism rather than a new one), overlap_scope 'none' (no pacing by prior fills — every tick is an independent draw), and the widened 09:45-15:30 window. This is what atr-open/ivr-open/otm-open/gex-mag/window-late/gex-open would each have been as separate arms — with overlap off and no position interaction, an entry filter is a deterministic function of a float this stream already records (entry_vol_realized_value, entry_vol_implied_value, etc. — see regime.py), so every one of those questions is a READ-SIDE split of this stream's own rows (analytics.by_regime), not a reason to run a fifth arm. Same reasoning for the stop question: a fully-marked open position's path contains every stop policy's outcome, so stop-none/stop-0.75-net/stop-2.0-side/strike-touch (Phase 3) are computed from these rows too, at 1x position cost and with exact pairing to control's own entries where the derivation validates.
control._gate_thresholds_note: regime_vix_pause_threshold/regime_vix1d_ratio_pause_threshold are sentinel-high (999), not null — those two gates are NOT null-safe in code (`params['regime_vix_pause_threshold']` is a required key with no is-not-None guard, and vix1d's `.get(key, 1.30)` returns None rather than the default for a PRESENT-but-null key, same crash class regime_atr_pause_threshold_pct had before 2026-08-07's fix). regime_atr_pause_threshold_pct and regime_gex_min_flip_distance_pct ARE null-safe (explicit `is not None` guards) and are turned off with null, matching the convention config.example.json already documents for the GEX magnitude gate.
